name: inline-word-roll
title: Inline Word Roll
description: Switch words beside a fixed prefix with an accelerating vertical roll; the whole line recenters as word lengths change.
useWhen: A headline keeps its opening phrase while cycling through audiences, benefits or outcomes.
Different word lengths should smoothly recenter the whole line during each switch.
avoidWhen: Every new word should remain in the sentence: use word-push.
Entire phrases should transform letter by letter: use kinetic-morph-text.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Fixed text
variables.description: Text that stays in place before the rolling word.

variables.label: Words
variables.default: leads | customers | subscribers | appointments | demos | quotes | registrants | trials | conversions

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Text size in pixels at full size. Wide lines scale down to fit.

variables.label: Initial frames per word
variables.description: Frames the first word holds (30 fps).

variables.label: Interval multiplier
variables.description: Each following hold is multiplied by this; 1 keeps a steady pace.
